# Derma Healer India - Complete Clinic Directory & Knowledge Base

> Derma Healer is Siwan's premier dermatology, aesthetic laser, and body contouring clinic located in Bihar, India. Spearheaded by expert dermatologists, the clinic provides USFDA-approved medical treatments for laser tattoo removal, acne scar resurfacing, laser hair removal, melasma, anti-aging, non-surgical body sculpting, and hair restoration.

## Detailed Clinical & Aesthetic Procedures

### 1. Laser & Pigmentation Treatments

#### Laser Tattoo Removal
- **Description:** Q-Switched Nd:YAG laser gently shatters unwanted tattoo ink particles into micro-fragments without damaging surrounding skin tissue.
- **Technology:** Advanced Q-Switched Nd:YAG Laser.
- **Ideal For:** Safe, precision removal of dark and multi-colored permanent tattoos with minimal scarring.
- **URL:** https://dermahealerindia.com/treatments/skin/tattoo-removal

#### Laser Hair Removal
- **Description:** USFDA-approved permanent laser hair reduction designed for all Indian skin types and all genders.
- **Technology:** Triple-wavelength diode laser.
- **Target Areas:** Face, underarms, arms, legs, back, chest, and full body.
- **URL:** https://dermahealerindia.com/treatments/hair/laser-hair-removal

#### Carbon Laser Toning ("Hollywood Carbon Peel")
- **Description:** Deeply exfoliates, absorbs skin impurities, shrinks enlarged pores, controls oil, and brightens dull skin using carbon lotion and Q-switched laser pulses.
- **Ideal For:** Instant skin glow, acne control, and pore tightening.

#### Melasma & Hyperpigmentation Treatment
- **Description:** Comprehensive care for brownish patches, freckles, sun spots, and uneven skin tone using custom chemical peels, Q-switched lasers, and targeted serums.
- **URL:** https://dermahealerindia.com/treatments/skin/melasma

---

### 2. Clinical Skin & Surgical Procedures

#### Acne & Laser Scar Removal
- **Description:** Stimulates new collagen and skin regeneration to erase deep acne pits, surgical scars, and post-injury marks.
- **Technology:** Fractional lasers, microneedling RF, and chemical exfoliation.

#### Vitiligo Surgery
- **Description:** Surgical restoration of natural skin color on stable white patches.
- **Techniques Used:** Punch Grafting and Suction Blister Grafting.

#### Wart, Skin Tag & Xanthelasma Removal
- **Description:** Safe, painless, and effective removal of skin tags, warts, and cholesterol deposits (Xanthelasma) around eyelids.
- **Techniques Used:** Radiofrequency electrosurgery, cryotherapy, and laser excision.

---

### 3. Hair Restoration & Scalp Care

#### Hair Loss & PRP Therapy
- **Description:** Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) therapy, mesotherapy, and growth factor concentrate (GFC) injections to arrest hair fall, stimulate dormant follicles, and increase hair density.
- **Ideal For:** Male and female pattern hair loss, hard-water induced damage, and thinning scalps.

---

### 4. Anti-Aging & Rejuvenation

#### HIFU (High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound) Non-Surgical Facelift
- **Description:** Non-invasive skin tightening and facial contouring that lifts sagging skin and reduces wrinkles by stimulating deep structural collagen in a single session.

#### HydraFacial
- **Description:** Multi-step clinical facial that detoxifies, exfoliates, extracts impurities, and deeply hydrates using nutrient-rich serums.

#### Vampire Facial
- **Description:** Celebrity-favorite procedure combining microneedling with PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) growth factors to boost collagen, smooth fine lines, and restore skin radiance.

#### Chemical Peels
- **Description:** Controlled medical-grade exfoliation that removes dead surface layers to improve texture, acne, and pigmentation.

---

### 5. Non-Surgical Body Sculpting & Women's Health

#### Fat Loss & Body Sculpting
- **Description:** Non-invasive fat reduction and body contouring targeting stubborn fat in the belly, thighs, arms, and love handles.
- **Technology:** HDPEM (High-Density Pulsed Electromagnetic) technology and fat-loss injections.

#### Urinary Incontinence (Kegel Chair Therapy)
- **Description:** Non-invasive electromagnetic chair therapy for age-related or post-pregnancy pelvic floor strengthening and bladder control leakage.
